ui_form.title: tag postfix
ui_form.description: Give the inference tag the model ID as postfix

ui_form.title: Trained model (task IDs)
ui_form.description: Identifies which trained checkpoint to use, as '<training-run-WORKFLOW_ID>-fold-<fold>/<model-best.pth.tar|model-end.pth.tar>' (fold is always 0 currently). No dynamic model picker exists yet (see migration-notes.md) — copy this from the training run whose checkpoint you want to use.

ui_form.title: Trained model (task IDs)
ui_form.description: Same value as the preprocessing task's TASK_IDS parameter above — identifies which trained checkpoint to load for inference.

ui_form.title: Run ID
ui_form.description: Not injected automatically (see migration-notes.md); only affects an unused directory the legacy script creates as a side effect. Any value is fine.
